moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-md3, written here): cubic-bezier(.2, 0, 0, 1), 300 ms (site motion_ms). The Material standard; default for corporate / product UI. Writable now as custom(M0,0 C .2,0 0,1 1,1); proposed alias md3.standard. Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.3 s) · ease (custom .2,0,0,1).
